shortDescription: British house prices fell 0.2% in August and were 0.4% lower than a year earlier, the first annual decline since November 2023, monthly figures from Lloyds showed on Monday.Economists polled by Reuters had a median forecast for a 0.1% monthly rise and a 0.2% annual increase.
